title: Learning-Based Speed Estimation from Accelerometer-Only Inertial Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2401.07468v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The proposed model, CarSpeedNet, estimates scalar vehicle speed from a window of three-axis smartphone acceleration, without gyroscope, wheel-odometry, vehicle-bus, or positioning input at inference. The reported experiment comprises 13.2 hours of on-road driving. Beyond the network comparison, a finite-context analysis treats window length as part of the sensing problem. For nested histories, the minimum Bayes mean-square error is non-increasing with context; a complementary cue-coverage relation links the same window to the amount of speed-dependent vibration presented to the network and to the observation horizon. At a 1-s input, CarSpeedNet is compared with five temporal-network alternatives; the effect of temporal context is then measured over six window lengths. On the 0.5-hour holdout, a 4-s window yielded a root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 1.8 m/s and a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.72 m/s, compared with 2.9 and 1.3 m/

translated_title: 基于学习的方法从仅加速度计的惯性传感中估计速度
translated_abstract: arXiv:2401.07468v4 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：提出的模型CarSpeedNet，从三轴智能手机加速度的时间窗口中估计标量车辆速度，在推理时无需陀螺仪、轮式里程计、车辆总线或定位输入。报告实验包含13.2小时的道路驾驶。除网络比较外，有限上下文分析将窗口长度视为传感问题的一部分。对于嵌套历史，最小贝叶斯均方误差随上下文不增加；互补的线索覆盖关系将同一窗口与呈现给网络的速度相关振动量及观测范围联系起来。在1秒输入下，CarSpeedNet与五种时间网络替代方案进行比较；随后在六个窗口长度上测量时间上下文的影响。在0.5小时保留集上，4秒窗口产生均方根误差（RMSE）为1.8米/秒，平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.72米/秒，而对比为2.9和1.3米/秒。
tldr: CarSpeedNet模型利用智能手机加速度数据的时间窗口，无需额外传感器即可估计车辆速度，在4秒窗口下实现RMSE 1.8米/秒，并系统分析了窗口长度对估计误差的影响。
en_tdlr: The CarSpeedNet model estimates vehicle speed from smartphone accelerometer windows without additional sensors, achieving an RMSE of 1.8 m/s with a 4-second window, while systematically analyzing the impact of window length on estimation error.
